cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: walking; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — standing; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — holds a towel folded against her chest; a city park with benches — holds an ice cream cone at chest height; a bridal room — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a Guan Yu temple — sitting on the ground; a small rural station with a wooden bench and a single platform — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — perched on a ledge or edge; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — swimming breaststroke; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing
